name: Starfighter
summary: **Starfighter** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Alien Genetics]]. A cross of their Lemon Alien Dawg and Tahoe Alien lines, both rooted in [[alien-technology|Alien Technology]] and [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] genetics, it was never released as feminized seed. It later became a parent of [[mac|MAC]].
